substack_body_markdown:
U.S. retail sales declined in July, the first drop in nine months, Reuters reported. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_1]]

MarketWatch identified cheaper gas and an “Amazon Prime hangover” as the chief culprits behind the slump. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_2]] CNN separately reported that U.S. consumers cut retail spending last month. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_3]]

The exact percentage or dollar amount of the decline is not specified, leaving the scale of the pullback unresolved.
